request.style: English, male baritone voice, storytelling, solo, acoustic guitar, fiddle, upright bass, piano, somber mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From Tirzah he went up the road
To Samaria, with a heavy load
He struck down Shallum, son of Jabesh
And took the throne for himself, the least

[Chorus]
Menahem son of Gadi reigned
In the thirty-ninth year, unchanged
He did what was evil in the Lord's sight
Holding power by might and rite

[Verse]
Tiphsah refused to open its gate
So he attacked, sealing its fate
He ripped open all the pregnant women
A brutal end for their broken homes

[Chorus]
Menahem son of Gadi reigned
In the thirty-ninth year, unchanged
He did what was evil in the Lord's sight
Holding power by might and rite

[Verse]
Pul king of Assyria came to the land
Menahem paid the silver demand
A thousand talents, heavy and cold
To keep the Assyrian forces held

[Chorus]
Menahem son of Gadi reigned
In the thirty-ninth year, unchanged
He did what was evil in the Lord's sight
Holding power by might and rite

[Outro]
Fifty shekels from every wealthy man
The king of Assyria withdrew then
Ten years in Samaria passed
In the shadow of the past
